title: Lemon Garlic Roast Chicken
steps: Heat oven to 425°F (220°C). Pat the chicken dry.
Halve one lemon and stuff the cavity with it, the garlic, and thyme.
Rub the skin with olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Roast 60–70 minutes until the thigh reads 165°F.
Rest 10 minutes, then squeeze the second lemon over the top before carving.

title: Weeknight Tomato Basil Pasta
steps: Cook spaghetti in salted water until just shy of al dente; reserve 1 cup pasta water.
Warm olive oil, add sliced garlic and pepper flakes until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add crushed tomatoes, simmer 10 minutes with a pinch of salt.
Toss in the pasta with a splash of pasta water until glossy.
Finish with torn basil and parmesan.

title: Sheet-Pan Chickpea & Veggie Bowl
steps: Heat oven to 425°F (220°C). Pat chickpeas dry.
Toss chickpeas and chopped vegetables with oil, cumin, and paprika on a sheet pan.
Roast 25 minutes, stirring once, until edges char slightly.
Serve over rice with your favorite sauce or yogurt.

title: Classic Beef Chili
steps: Brown the beef with diced onion and garlic over medium-high heat; drain excess fat.
Stir in chili powder and cumin, toast 1 minute.
Add tomatoes and beans, bring to a simmer.
Cook uncovered 35–40 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thickened.
Season with salt to taste and serve.

title: Miso-Glazed Salmon
steps: Whisk miso, honey, rice vinegar, and sesame oil.
Brush over salmon and marinate 10 minutes if time allows.
Broil or pan-sear 6–8 minutes until caramelized and just cooked through.
Top with sesame seeds and sliced scallions.

title: Morning Oat Pancakes
steps: Blend all ingredients until mostly smooth.
Let batter rest 5 minutes to thicken.
Cook 1/4-cup portions on a lightly oiled griddle, 2–3 minutes per side.
Serve with fruit or maple syrup.

title: Green Lentil Soup
steps: Sauté diced carrot, celery, and onion in olive oil until soft, about 6 minutes.
Add garlic and cumin, cook 1 minute.
Stir in lentils and broth; bring to a boil, then simmer 30 minutes until tender.
Blend a portion for creaminess if desired, then season and serve.

title: No-Bake Peanut Butter Oat Bites
steps: Stir all ingredients together in a bowl until a thick dough forms.
Chill 10 minutes for easier rolling.
Roll into 1-inch balls.
Store in the fridge up to a week.

title: Thai-Style Veggie Stir-Fry
steps: Whisk soy sauce, brown sugar, and lime juice for the sauce.
Stir-fry garlic in hot oil 30 seconds, then add vegetables.
Cook 5–6 minutes over high heat until crisp-tender.
Pour in the sauce and toss 1 minute until glossy.
Serve over rice.

title: Classic Banana Bread
steps: Heat oven to 350°F (175°C) and grease a loaf pan.
Mash bananas, then mix in melted butter, sugar, egg, and vanilla.
Sprinkle baking soda and salt over the mixture and stir in.
Fold in flour until just combined.
Bake 55–65 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
